newsitem.title: GREECE: BROKER MORDECHAI RESIGNS FROM GUARANTEE FUND BOARD.
newsitem.headline: BROKER MORDECHAI RESIGNS FROM GUARANTEE FUND BOARD.

text.p: Isaac Mordechai, managing director of ABN AMRO Axias Securities and a member of the board of directors of the exchange's guarantee fund resigned from the board on Thursday, he told Reuters.
Mordechai who announced his decision during the brokers association (SMEHA) meeting on Tuesday is also a member of the board of the exchange's clearing house -- Apothetirion Titlon SA.
He cited personal reasons for his decision.
"I intend to stay on the board of the clearing house. I happen to be a romantic who dreams of the day of dematerialisation at the exchange," Mordechai told Reuters on Wednesday.
The clearing house and the exchange are working towards full dematerialisation -- paperless trading -- in 1997. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
